body:
1. Optimize bin/node-launcher.sh with a POSIX-safe resolve_full_path (eliminating dirname/basename subshell forks and lazily caching REAL_HOME/REAL_USER_HOME) and a strict numeric C++ node -v fast-path (with immediate reject on < 22.19 and fallback to node -e on unparseable output).
2. Make runLiveMechanicalProbes in evals/runner.mjs self-contained using a hermetic ADLC fixture via writeAdlcTickets and AGB_WORKER_TICKET, plus an explicit out-of-scope denial probe.
3. Add evals/live-bench.mjs with 3 deterministic live runtime evaluations (40-vector policy corpus, hook latency breakdown, orchestrator overhead) and comprehensive tests in test/evals.test.mjs and test/node-launcher.test.mjs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- shellcheck -s sh bin/node-launcher.sh bin/hook-runner.sh exits 0.
- node --test test/node-launcher.test.mjs test/evals.test.mjs exits 0.
- node evals/runner.mjs --write-report docs/benchmarks/marketplace-eval-report.md exits 0.
- npm test && npm run coverage:check && npm run plugin:validate exits 0.
title: Optimize node-launcher.sh version fast-path and add live runtime & policy corpus evals
